internal_diagnostics: Function Code 0x07 Read Exception Status (serial only) — 8 device-specific exception-status bits in a single response byte.

Function Code 0x08 Diagnostics (serial only) — 14 sub-functions covering loopback (sub 0), Restart Communications Option (sub 1), Diagnostic Register read (sub 2), Force Listen Only Mode (sub 4), Clear Counters (sub 10), and individual counter reads (sub 11..18, 20).
Function Code 0x0B Get Comm Event Counter (serial only) — 2-byte Status + 2-byte Event Count.
Function Code 0x0C Get Comm Event Log (serial only) — Status + Event Count + Message Count + ≤ 64 event bytes.
Function Code 0x11 Report Server ID (serial only) — Server ID + Run Indicator Status (0xFF / 0x00) + device-specific extra bytes.
Built-in exception-response mechanism — server tells the client exactly which validation gate failed without requiring out-of-band debugging.
exception_response_observability: Function-code-MSB on response byte 0 — distinguishes normal vs exception response.

Exception code (1 byte): 0x01 ILLEGAL FUNCTION, 0x02 ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS, 0x03 ILLEGAL DATA VALUE, 0x04 SERVER DEVICE FAILURE, 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE, 0x06 SERVER DEVICE BUSY, 0x08 MEMORY PARITY ERROR, 0x0A GATEWAY PATH UNAVAILABLE, 0x0B GATEWAY TARGET DEVICE FAILED TO RESPOND.

Diagnostic counters via FC 0x08 sub-codes 11..18 — Bus Message Count, Bus Comm Error Count, Bus Exception Error Count, Server Message Count, Server No Response Count, Server NAK Count, Server Busy Count, Bus Character Overrun Count.
fields.notes: MODBUS provides protocol-level observability (exception responses + diagnostic counters + comm event log) rather than silicon-level DFT (scan chain, MBIST, ATPG). Modern SoC-integrated MODBUS IP from FPGA vendors (Xilinx, Intel/Altera, Microchip) adds standard scan insertion at the IP-license level; the MODBUS spec itself only governs the on-the-wire byte sequence and timing.
